e.title: **三层标准叠在一起，而最上面那层是从 fork 里抽出来当库用的**：巴西 **Open Insurance 认证测试套件**——**上一层是 Open Banking 认证套件，再上一层是 OpenID 基金会的 FAPI 套件**；**⭐ 它逐字写明这套做法的取舍**（**逐字**「**In effect, the OBB conformance suite is a dependency of this project, in exactly the same way that JUnit is.**」）；**⭐ 并逐字承认代价**（**逐字**「**features introduced into the OBB codebase aren’t immediately available to us**」）
e.title_en: Three layers of standards stacked, with the top layer pulled out of a fork and used as a library: the Brazilian Open Insurance conformance suite sits on top of the Open Banking conformance suite, which in turn is a fork of the OpenID Foundation FAPI suite; the project states its central design choice verbatim, that the banking conformance suite is a dependency of this project in exactly the same way that JUnit is, and states the cost of that choice verbatim as well, that features introduced into the banking codebase are not immediately available here.
e.title_hk: **三層標準疊在一起，而最上面那層是從 fork 裡抽出來當庫用的**：巴西 **Open Insurance 認證測試套件**——**上一層是 Open Banking 認證套件，再上一層是 OpenID 基金會的 FAPI 套件**；**⭐ 它逐字寫明這套做法的取捨**（**逐字**「**In effect, the OBB conformance suite is a dependency of this project, in exactly the same way that JUnit is.**」）；**⭐ 並逐字承認代價**（**逐字**「**features introduced into the OBB codebase aren’t immediately available to us**」）
e.summary: **raidiam-conformance/open-insurance/open-insurance-brasil**（GitLab）**是巴西 **Open Insurance** 认证的测试套件**——**⭐ 而它最有价值的部分不是测试本身，而是它逐字写下的**为什么这样搭**：**⭐⭐⭐ ①** 它**不 fork**：**逐字**「**As OBB CS is itself a fork of another FOSS project run by the OpenID Foundation, it was considered that we could simply fork that project again, or fork the OBB CS, but maintaining a single fork is problematic enough, so a spike was performed to see if the OPIN-specific code could be pulled out into effectively a library project. That is this project.**」**——**⭐ 即**它把「**再 fork 一次**」这个看起来最自然的做法**先否掉**，**改成把保险费部分抽成一个**库**；**⭐⭐⭐ ② 依赖链是**三层标准****：**OpenID 基金会 FAPI 套件 → Open Banking Brasil 认证套件 → 本仓库（Open Insurance）**；**它的 `pom.xml` 逐字为** `<name>Open Insurance Brasil Conformance Library</name>`、**依赖** `fapi-conformance-suite`、**版本属性逐字为** `<fapi.conformance.version>0.0.2-7498ca78</fapi.conformance.version>`（**即**一个固定版本号＋上游短提交号**）；**⭐⭐⭐ ③ 取舍是双向写明的**：**优点**（**构建稳定**、**维护代码极少**、**不必等上游那套「经常不稳、总是很慢」的功能测试**）**与**缺点**（**上游新功能不会立刻可用**，**须等其合入 master 再改版本号**）**；**⭐⭐ ④ 源码几乎只剩测试计划**——**逐字**「**The bulk of the code lives in dependencies, so the source code of this is sparse and consists almost entirely of OPIN test plans, modules and their supporting code.**」**；**⭐ 测试模块按**险种**组织**（**`phase1` 下可见** `autoInsurance`、`cyberRisk`、`directorsOfficersLiability`、`engineering`、`exportCredit` **等**；**`phase3` 下** `quotePersonLife`、`quoteHousing`、`quoteRural`、`quoteTransport` **等，**且同一险种留下 `v1n9`／`v1n11`／`v2` 三代**）；**⚠️ 本次未构建、未运行任何测试、未读 Java 源码，**也未核实它是否获得任何监管认可**。
e.summary_hk: **raidiam-conformance/open-insurance/open-insurance-brasil**（GitLab）**是巴西 **Open Insurance** 認證的測試套件**——**⭐ 而它最有價值的部分不是測試本身，而是它逐字寫下的**為什麼這樣搭**：**⭐⭐⭐ ①** 它**不 fork**：**逐字**「**maintaining a single fork is problematic enough, so a spike was performed to see if the OPIN-specific code could be pulled out into effectively a library project. That is this project.**」**——**⭐ 即**它把「**再 fork 一次**」這個最自然的做法**先否掉**；**⭐⭐⭐ ② 依賴鏈是**三層標準****：**OpenID 基金會 FAPI 套件 → Open Banking Brasil 認證套件 → 本倉庫**；**`pom.xml` 逐字為** `<name>Open Insurance Brasil Conformance Library</name>`、**依賴** `fapi-conformance-suite`、**版本屬性逐字為** `<fapi.conformance.version>0.0.2-7498ca78</fapi.conformance.version>`；**⭐⭐⭐ ③ 取捨是雙向寫明的**（**優點**：**構建穩定**、**維護程式碼極少**、**不必等上游那套「經常不穩、總是很慢」的功能測試**；**缺點**：**上游新功能不會立刻可用**）**；**⭐⭐ ④ 原始碼幾乎只剩測試計劃**（**逐字**「**The bulk of the code lives in dependencies, so the source code of this is sparse and consists almost entirely of OPIN test plans, modules and their supporting code.**」）**；**⭐ 測試模組按**險種**組織**，**且同一險種留下 `v1n9`／`v1n11`／`v2` 三代**；**⚠️ 本次未構建、未運行任何測試、未讀 Java 原始碼**。
e.summary_en: The repository `raidiam-conformance/open-insurance/open-insurance-brasil` on GitLab **is the conformance test suite for the Brazilian Open Insurance standard**, and **its most valuable part is not the tests themselves but the reasoning it writes down verbatim about how it is assembled**: it rejects the obvious move of forking again, stating that because the banking suite is itself a fork of an OpenID Foundation project, it was considered that the banking suite could simply be forked again, but that maintaining a single fork is already problematic enough, so an investigation was run to see whether the insurance-specific code could be pulled out into effectively a library project, and that is what this repository is. **The dependency chain is therefore three layers of standards**: the OpenID Foundation FAPI suite, then the Brazilian Open Banking conformance suite, then this insurance suite, whose build file names itself an Open Insurance Brasil Conformance Library and depends on the FAPI conformance suite through a version property that combines a rarely changing version number with a short commit hash of the upstream project. **The tradeoffs are stated in both directions**: build stability, very little code to maintain, and not having to wait for the upstream functional tests that it calls often flaky and always long-winded, against the cost that features introduced upstream are not immediately available here. **The source is deliberately sparse**, consisting almost entirely of insurance test plans and their supporting code, and the test modules are organised by line of business, with parallel versions of the same line kept side by side. **Nothing was built, no test was run, no Java source was read, and whether any regulator recognises this suite was not verified.**
e.body:
**raidiam-conformance/open-insurance/open-insurance-brasil**（**GitLab 仓库**）**是巴西 **Open Insurance**（保险业数据共享与接口标准）认证用的**测试套件**。**本次实测**：**★7**、**fork 4**、**创建 2021-12-21**、**最后活动 2026-09-08**、**默认分支 `main`**、**GitLab 项目接口未报出许可**（**本次未在仓库根看到 `LICENSE`**）。**本条目属于本轮主题**「**同源多形：一份内容、好几种形态，且必须对得上**」**；**本词条认为它是本轮四条里唯一一条**把「**这件事为什么要这么做**」写成正式文档**的**。**仓库根实测含** `pom.xml`、`Dockerfile`、`Makefile`、`.gitlab-ci.yml`、`README.md`、**六个 docker-compose 变体**（`docker-compose.yml`、`-dev`、`-dev-mac`、`-dev-mac-nodocker`、`-dev-linux-nodocker`、`-localtest`），**以及目录** `src/`、`scripts/`、`docs/`、`terraform/`、`httpd/`、`.gitlab/`、`.idea/`。

**可核实信息（均 README、`docs/DEVGUIDE.md`、`pom.xml` 与 GitLab 接口实测）**：**⭐⭐⭐ ① 文档的第一节标题就是「为什么会有这个东西」**——`docs/DEVGUIDE.md`（**实测 3,795 字节**）**的 Why this exists 一节逐字**：**「**In the past, the Open Insurance Conformance Suite - hereafter referred to as OPIN CS - has been a deployment of the same codebase as the Open Banking Brasil Conformance Suite - hereafter referred to as OBB CS - with different configuration parameters to surface different test plans. While this was a useful mechanism it tied two discrete development lifecycles together in ways which were undesirable. One project would often be impacted by bugs in another stream, the deployment of OPIN CS was tied to OBB CS work and so forth.**」**——**⭐ 即**它先交代**过去是「同一份代码、两套配置」**，**再说明那样做的具体代价**（**两个开发节奏被绑在一起、一个项目常被另一条线的 bug 波及**）。**⭐⭐⭐ ② 它明确否掉了「再 fork 一次」并给出替代方案**——**逐字**：**「**As OBB CS is itself a fork of another FOSS project run by the OpenID Foundation, it was considered that we could simply fork that project again, or fork the OBB CS, but maintaining a single fork is problematic enough, so a spike was performed to see if the OPIN-specific code could be pulled out into effectively a library project. That is this project.**」**。**⭐ 本词条认为这是本轮最值得抄的一处推理链**：**① 上游本身就是别人的 fork → ② 所以「再 fork」看起来顺理成章 → ③ 但「维护一个 fork 已经够麻烦」→ ④ 于是先做一次 spike 验证「能不能把保险费那部分抽成一个库」→ ⑤ 结果就是这个仓库**。**⭐ 即**它把「**不这么做**」的理由**与「**这么做**」的做法**写在同一个文件里**。**⭐⭐⭐ ③ 复用的具体机制被写成可核对的四步**——**逐字**：**「**The OBB CS code is commonly packaged as a Spring Boot fatjar, which is subsequently packaged as a docker image which then gets deployed onto EKS clusters. The build pipeline has been modified so that the Java code is also packaged as a simple Java jar which is published to a Maven repositoru. This jar is available for use by the OPIN CS project, which first of all uses it as a compile-time dependency, then also packages itself as a Spring Boot fatjar with the OPIN code included.**」**（**原文该处把 repository 拼成了 repositoru，本词条照原文引用**）**——**⭐ 即**上游的构建流水线**被改过一次**（**多产出一个普通 jar 并发到 Maven 仓库**），**好让下游能把它当**编译期依赖**用**。**⭐⭐⭐ ④ 取舍写成对等的两节**——**优点三处逐字**：**「**Stability of build. The OPIN CS project depends on a specific, tested release of the OBB CS code, so any breaking changes to OBB CS will not impact this project at all.**」、**「**Much less code to maintain. The bulk of the code lives in dependencies, so the source code of this is sparse and consists almost entirely of OPIN test plans, modules and their supporting code.**」、**「**We do not need to wait for the often-flaky, always long-winded OBB functional tests to complete before we can deploy.**」；**缺点逐字**：**「**The main tradeoff for this stability is that features introduced into the OBB codebase aren’t immediately available to us. As we have a dependency expressed through Maven co-ordinates on a specific release to master of the OBB code, we need to wait until a change is merged to master before we can then pull that version in to our builds.**」**，**并以一句话定性**：**「**In effect, the OBB conformance suite is a dependency of this project, in exactly the same way that JUnit is.**」**。**⭐ 即**「**上游的那套认证套件，对本项目来说就是一个依赖，跟 JUnit 一样**」——**⭐ 本词条认为这句是本轮四条里把**依赖关系**说得最直白的一句**。**⭐⭐ ⑤ 版本钉法被专门解释**——DEVGUIDE 有一节标题逐字为**「**What’s a Maven co-ordinate?**」**，**并给出 `pom.xml` 里的依赖片段**（`groupId` 为 `net.openid`、`artifactId` 为 `fapi-conformance-suite`、**版本为** `${fapi.conformance.version}`、**classifier 为** `tests`、**scope 为** `test`**）**；**并逐字解释**「**The version co-ordinate used for this is, to keep things simple, a version number which rarely changes, followed by the short sha of the git revision which represents the master branch of the OBB project at any given time.**」**——**⭐ 本词条实测** `pom.xml`（**8,055 字节**）**里的值正是这个形状**：**逐字** `<fapi.conformance.version>0.0.2-7498ca78</fapi.conformance.version>`（**即**版本 `0.0.2` ＋ 上游短提交号 `7498ca78`**）**。**⭐⭐ ⑥ 测试模块按**险种**组织，且同一险种保留多代版本**——**本次经 GitLab 目录接口分页枚举（每页 100 条）到第 30 页仍未结束，故实测**至少 3,000 条路径**，**其中 **1,777 个 `.java` 文件**；**测试模块组实测为** `phase1`、`phase3`、`fvp`、`pcm`、`support`、`v1`；**`phase1` 下可见** `autoInsurance`、`autoExtendedWarranty`、`capitalization`、`condominium`、`cyberRisk`、`directorsOfficersLiability`、`domesticCredit`、`electronic`、`engineering`、`environmentalLiability`、`equipmentBreakdown`、`errorsOmissionsLiability`、`exportCredit`、`extendedWarranty`、`financialRisk`、`generalLiability` **等按险种分目录**；**`phase3` 下为** `quote`＋险种**（**如** `quotePersonLife`、`quoteHousing`、`quoteRural`、`quoteTransport`、`quotePatrimonialHome`、`quotePatrimonialEngineering`、`quotePatrimonialDiversifiedRisks` **等**），**且**多个险种下**并列保留** `v1n9`、`v1n11`、`v2` **三代**（**⭐ 即**同一个险种的**不同接口版本**各有自己的测试计划**，**且**并存**而不是互相覆盖**）；**`fvp` 下含** `claimNotification`、`endorsement`、`quote`、`raffle`、`withdraw`（**其下又有** `capitalizationTitle` **与** `pension/lead`**）**；**`pcm` 下含** `consent/funnel` **与** `metrics`。**⭐ 即**「**同一套标准的不同版本、同一条业务链的不同环节**」**在这份目录结构里是**可见的**。**⭐⭐ ⑦ 工程配置也可核实**：`pom.xml` **逐字给出** `<artifactId>openinsurance</artifactId>`、`<version>0.0.1-SNAPSHOT</version>`、`<name>Open Insurance Brasil Conformance Library</name>`、`spring-boot-starter-parent` **版本** `2.7.17`、**以及** `spring-security-core` `5.2.8.RELEASE`、`hamcrest` `2.1`、`mockito-core` `3.1.0`、**`archunit` `1.4.1`**、`gson` `2.10.1`、`json-path` `2.4.0`；**⭐ 其中 `.archunit` 是**架构测试**库**——**⭐ 即**这份「只剩测试计划」的代码**还被架构规则约束着**（**⚠️ 本次未读其架构规则内容，故不主张它约束了什么**）；**根目录另有** `terraform/`（**基础设施即代码**）**与** `scripts/configs/{fvp,phase2,phase3}/v2/generated`（**生成的配置**）**。**⭐ ⑧ 与池内条目的关系**：**本站 [[susep-open-insurance]] 与 [[susep-sro]] 记录的是**巴西监管方（SUSEP）**一侧**，**[[acord]]、[[acord-mcp-architecture]]、[[kong-insurance-api-bundle]]、[[openinsurance]]、[[insurance-regulatory-mcp]] 覆盖**标准与接口**的相邻主题**，**而本条补上的是**「**标准怎么被认证**」这一层**——**⭐ 即**一份标准**在被大量实现之后，**需要有一个**可重复执行的一致性测试**来判定某个实现算不算合规**；**它同时与 [[open-risk-api]]、[[eiopa-registers]] 一类「监管数据接口」条目构成同一主题的不同侧面**。

**对 RIAA**：**本条与 [[susep-open-insurance]]、[[acord]] 应当并读**——**它给的是「保险数据共享标准落地」这件事里最少被写到的一环**：**不是接口定义，而是**判定一个实现是否合规的那套测试**；**⭐ 而它对写工程文档的启示同样直接**：**当你要在两个上游之间做选择时，把「为什么不那样做」和「这样做的代价」都写下来**。

**⚠️ 本词条如实标注**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次没有构建、没有运行任何测试、没有部署任何环境**（**未装 JDK 或 Maven、未 `mvn test`、未起任何容器、未访问任何被测试的接口**），**故不主张**任何测试计划按所述执行、不主张任何实现能通过认证、也不主张该套件当前的通过状态。**② ⚠️⚠️ 未读任何 Java 源码**——**本次只读了** `README.md`（703 字节）、`docs/DEVGUIDE.md`（3,795 字节）、`pom.xml`（8,055 字节）**与目录清单**，**故不主张**测试用例的内容、断言强度、覆盖了哪些接口、以及 `support/` 与 `v1/` 两个模块组的用途。**⚠️ 本条目最需后续核实的一处**。**③ ⚠️ 未核实该套件与监管的关系**：**本次未访问任何 SUSEP 或 Open Insurance Brasil 官方页面、未核实该套件是否被指定为官方认证工具、也未核实「通过」意味着什么**；**本词条只记录仓库自述**。**④ ⚠️ 目录清单是**分页枚举到第 30 页为止**的结果**（**每页 100 条、30 页均为满页**），**故「至少 3,000 条路径」是**下界**而不是总数**；**「1,777 个 `.java` 文件」为本次枚举范围内实测值**。**⑤ ⚠️ 未核实许可**：**GitLab 项目接口未报出许可**，**本次在仓库根清单里也没有看到 `LICENSE` 文件**——**故本词条不主张其许可状态**（**⭐ 本词条按惯例把「未声明许可」记为**权利不明**，**而不是记为「无版权」**）。**⑥ ⚠️ 未核实** `terraform/` **与** `httpd/` **的实际内容**、**未读 `.gitlab-ci.yml`**、**未核实 CI 当前是否通过**。**⑦ ⚠️ 未核实维护方背景**（**项目路径中的 RaidiAM 与 Open Banking Brasil 的关系本次未查**）；**★7、fork 4 是该仓库在 GitLab 上的实测值，不构成质量证据**。**⑧ ⚠️ 创建 2021-12-21 在解冻窗口之外、最后活动 2026-09-08 在窗口之内**——**本次按惯例把这一处写在这里**：**本条的缺口是「**标准的一致性测试套件**」这一形态此前池内没有对应物**（**池内条目覆盖标准本身、监管数据接口与保险 API 封装，但没有一条记录「判定实现是否合规的那套测试」**）。**⑨ ⚠️ 本条目所记为 2026-09-11 所见**。 **⑩ ⚠️ 引号约定**：**本条目逐字引用英文原文时，把原文里的 ASCII 撇号（`aren’t` 一处、`What’s` 一处）写作 ’**——**以维持本词条不出现 ASCII 单引号的约定（引文内容未改，**其中 `repositoru` 一处为原文拼写，**已逐字保留并注明**）**。

**raidiam-conformance/open-insurance/open-insurance-brasil**（**GitLab 倉庫**）**是巴西 **Open Insurance**（保險業資料共享與介面標準）認證用的**測試套件**。**本次實測**：**★7**、**fork 4**、**建立 2021-12-21**、**最後活動 2026-09-08**、**預設分支 `main`**、**GitLab 專案介面未報出許可**。**本條目屬於本輪主題**「**同源多形：一份內容、好幾種形態，且必須對得上**」**。

**可核實資訊（均 README、`docs/DEVGUIDE.md`、`pom.xml` 與 GitLab 介面實測）**：**⭐⭐⭐ ① 文件的第一節標題就是「為什麼會有這個東西」**——Why this exists 一節逐字**：**「**In the past, the Open Insurance Conformance Suite - hereafter referred to as OPIN CS - has been a deployment of the same codebase as the Open Banking Brasil Conformance Suite - hereafter referred to as OBB CS - with different configuration parameters to surface different test plans. While this was a useful mechanism it tied two discrete development lifecycles together in ways which were undesirable.**」**。**⭐⭐⭐ ② 它明確否掉了「再 fork 一次」並給出替代方案**——**逐字**：**「**maintaining a single fork is problematic enough, so a spike was performed to see if the OPIN-specific code could be pulled out into effectively a library project. That is this project.**」**——**⭐ 即**它把「**不這麼做**」的理由**與「**這麼做**」的做法**寫在同一個檔案裡**。**⭐⭐⭐ ③ 復用的具體機制被寫成可核對的四步**——**逐字**：**「**The OBB CS code is commonly packaged as a Spring Boot fatjar, which is subsequently packaged as a docker image which then gets deployed onto EKS clusters. The build pipeline has been modified so that the Java code is also packaged as a simple Java jar which is published to a Maven repositoru. This jar is available for use by the OPIN CS project, which first of all uses it as a compile-time dependency, then also packages itself as a Spring Boot fatjar with the OPIN code included.**」**（**`repositoru` 為原文拼寫，照原文引用**）**。**⭐⭐⭐ ④ 取捨寫成對等的兩節**——**優點逐字**：**「**Stability of build. The OPIN CS project depends on a specific, tested release of the OBB CS code, so any breaking changes to OBB CS will not impact this project at all.**」、**「**Much less code to maintain. The bulk of the code lives in dependencies, so the source code of this is sparse and consists almost entirely of OPIN test plans, modules and their supporting code.**」、**「**We do not need to wait for the often-flaky, always long-winded OBB functional tests to complete before we can deploy.**」；**缺點逐字**：**「**The main tradeoff for this stability is that features introduced into the OBB codebase aren’t immediately available to us.**」**，**並以一句定性**：**「**In effect, the OBB conformance suite is a dependency of this project, in exactly the same way that JUnit is.**」**。**⭐⭐ ⑤ 版本釘法被專門解釋**——DEVGUIDE 有一節標題逐字為**「**What’s a Maven co-ordinate?**」**，**並逐字解釋**「**a version number which rarely changes, followed by the short sha of the git revision which represents the master branch of the OBB project**」**；**⭐ 本次實測** `pom.xml` **裡的值正是這個形狀**：**逐字** `<fapi.conformance.version>0.0.2-7498ca78</fapi.conformance.version>`。**⭐⭐ ⑥ 測試模組按**險種**組織，且同一險種保留多代版本**——**目錄介面分頁列舉到第 30 頁仍未結束，故實測**至少 3,000 條路徑**、**其中 **1,777 個 `.java` 檔**；**模組組為** `phase1`、`phase3`、`fvp`、`pcm`、`support`、`v1`；**`phase1` 下按險種分目錄**（`autoInsurance`、`cyberRisk`、`directorsOfficersLiability`、`engineering`、`exportCredit` **等**），**`phase3` 下為** `quote`＋險種**（**含** `quotePersonLife`、`quoteHousing`、`quoteRural`、`quoteTransport`**），**且多個險種下並列保留** `v1n9`、`v1n11`、`v2` **三代**。**⭐⭐ ⑦ 工程配置也可核實**：`pom.xml` **逐字給出** `<name>Open Insurance Brasil Conformance Library</name>`、`spring-boot-starter-parent` `2.7.17`、**以及** `archunit` `1.4.1`（**架構測試**）**、**`mockito-core` `3.1.0`、`gson` `2.10.1`**；**根目錄另有** `terraform/` **與** `scripts/configs/{fvp,phase2,phase3}/v2/generated`**。**⭐ ⑧ 與池內條目的關係**：**本站 [[susep-open-insurance]]、[[acord]]、[[openinsurance]]、[[kong-insurance-api-bundle]] 覆蓋標準與介面的相鄰主題**，**而本條補上的是**「**標準怎麼被認證**」這一層**。

**對 RIAA**：**本條與 [[susep-open-insurance]]、[[acord]] 應當並讀**——**它給的是「保險資料共享標準落地」這件事裡最少被寫到的一環**：**不是介面定義，而是**判定一個實作是否合規的那套測試**。

**⚠️ 本詞條如實標註**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次沒有構建、沒有運行任何測試、沒有部署任何環境**，**故不主張**任何測試計劃按所述執行、不主張任何實作能通過認證。**② ⚠️⚠️ 未讀任何 Java 原始碼**——**只讀了** `README.md`、`docs/DEVGUIDE.md`、`pom.xml` **與目錄清單**。**⚠️ 本條目最需後續核實的一處**。**③ ⚠️ 未核實該套件與監管的關係**（**未訪問 SUSEP 或 Open Insurance Brasil 官方頁面、未核實「通過」意味著什麼**）。**④ ⚠️ 目錄清單是**分頁列舉到第 30 頁為止**的結果**，**故「至少 3,000 條路徑」是**下界**。**⑤ ⚠️ 未核實許可**：**GitLab 介面未報出許可，**倉庫根也未見 `LICENSE`**——**故不主張其許可狀態**（**按慣例記為**權利不明****）。**⑥ ⚠️ 未核實** `terraform/` **與** `httpd/` **內容、未讀 `.gitlab-ci.yml`**。**⑦ ⚠️ 未核實維護方背景**；**★7／fork 4 不構成品質證據**。**⑧ ⚠️ 建立 2021-12-21 在解凍窗口之外、最後活動 2026-09-08 在窗口之內**——**本條的缺口是「**標準的一致性測試套件**」這一形態此前池內沒有對應物**。**⑨ ⚠️ 本條目所記為 2026-09-11 所見**。 **⑩ ⚠️ 引號約定**：**本條目逐字引用英文原文時，把原文裡的 ASCII 撇號（`aren’t`、`What’s`）寫作 ’**——**以維持本詞條不出現 ASCII 單引號的約定（引文內容未改）**。

The GitLab repository `raidiam-conformance/open-insurance/open-insurance-brasil` **is the conformance test suite used for certification against the Brazilian Open Insurance standard**. **Measured this round**: **7 stars**, **4 forks**, **created 2021-12-21**, **last activity 2026-09-08**, **default branch `main`**, and **no licence reported** by the GitLab project API, with no licence file seen at the repository root. **This entry belongs to the round theme of one source taking several forms, and of those forms having to agree.**

**Verified information, all measured from the README, the developer guide, the build file and the GitLab API**: **first, the first section of its documentation is why the thing exists at all.** The developer guide, measuring 3,795 bytes, states verbatim that in the past the insurance conformance suite had been a deployment of the same codebase as the banking conformance suite with different configuration parameters to surface different test plans, and that while this was useful it tied two discrete development lifecycles together in ways that were undesirable, one project often being impacted by bugs in another stream. **It first explains what the previous arrangement cost, in specifics.** **Second, it explicitly rejects forking again and states the alternative**, verbatim: because the banking suite is itself a fork of another free software project run by the OpenID Foundation, it was considered that the banking suite could simply be forked again, but maintaining a single fork is problematic enough, so an investigation was run to see whether the insurance-specific code could be pulled out into effectively a library project, **and that is what this repository is**. **This entry considers that reasoning chain the most copyable thing of the round: the upstream is itself somebody else fork, so forking again looks natural, but maintaining one fork is already troublesome, so a spike was run to test whether the insurance part could become a library, and the result is this project.** **Third, the reuse mechanism is written as four checkable steps**: the banking code is normally packaged as a Spring Boot fatjar and then as a docker image deployed to Kubernetes clusters; the build pipeline was modified so the Java code is also packaged as a plain Java jar published to a Maven repository; this repository consumes it first as a compile-time dependency and then packages itself as a Spring Boot fatjar with its own code included. **The upstream build pipeline was changed once, to emit an extra artefact, purely so that a downstream project could depend on it.** **Fourth, the tradeoffs are given as two matching sections.** The stated advantages, verbatim, are stability of build, because the dependency is on a specific, tested release so breaking changes upstream cannot affect this project; much less code to maintain, because the bulk of the code lives in dependencies and the source here is sparse and consists almost entirely of insurance test plans, modules and their supporting code; and not having to wait for the upstream functional tests that it calls often flaky and always long-winded. The stated disadvantage, verbatim, is that features introduced upstream are not immediately available, because the dependency is expressed through Maven coordinates on a specific release of the upstream master branch, so a change must be merged upstream before it can be pulled in. The section closes with the sentence this entry considers the plainest statement of a dependency relationship of the round: that in effect the banking conformance suite is a dependency of this project, in exactly the same way that JUnit is. **Fifth, the version pinning is explained on its own**: a section asks what a Maven coordinate is and gives the dependency block, naming the group, the artefact, the version property, the classifier and the test scope, then explains verbatim that the version coordinate is a number which rarely changes followed by the short commit hash of the upstream master branch at any given time. **The measured value in the build file is exactly that shape**, a three-part version followed by an eight-character hash. **Sixth, the test modules are organised by line of business, and several lines keep multiple generations side by side**: enumeration through the GitLab tree interface reached thirty full pages of one hundred entries each without ending, so **at least three thousand paths were measured, including 1,777 Java files**; the module groups are a discovery and onboarding phase, a later phase, a functional validation phase, a consent and metrics group, a support group and a version group; the first phase contains directories for motor insurance, cyber risk, directors and officers liability, engineering and export credit among others; the later phase holds quote plans per line, including life, housing, rural and transport, with several lines keeping three parallel generations of interface version rather than overwriting one another; and the validation group covers claim notification, endorsement, quote, raffle and withdrawal, the last splitting into a capitalisation title branch and a pension branch with a lead sub-branch. **The structure makes visible both the different versions of one standard and the different stages of one business chain.** **Seventh, the build configuration is checkable too**: the build file names itself an Open Insurance Brasil Conformance Library, inherits from a Spring Boot parent at version 2.7.17, and declares dependencies including Spring Security, Hamcrest, Mockito, an architecture testing library, Gson and a JSON path library, with a Terraform directory and generated configuration directories at the root. **The architecture testing dependency is notable because it means even this sparse code is constrained by architecture rules, though those rules were not read here.** **Eighth, relative to existing entries**: the pooled `[[susep-open-insurance]]` and `[[susep-sro]]` entries record the Brazilian regulator side, and `[[acord]]`, `[[acord-mcp-architecture]]`, `[[kong-insurance-api-bundle]]`, `[[openinsurance]]` and `[[insurance-regulatory-mcp]]` cover adjacent standard and interface topics, while this entry supplies the layer least often written about: **not the interface definition, but the repeatable consistency test that decides whether an implementation counts as compliant.**

**For RIAA**: **this entry reads alongside [[susep-open-insurance]] and [[acord]]**, because **it documents the least-documented link in making an insurance data-sharing standard real**, and because its documentation practice transfers directly: when choosing between two upstreams, write down both why the alternative was rejected and what the chosen path costs.

**Marked honestly by this entry**: **first, nothing was built, no test was run and no environment was deployed** — no JDK or Maven was installed, no test phase was executed, no container was started and no tested interface was contacted — **so no test plan is claimed to execute as described, no implementation is claimed to pass certification and no current pass status is claimed**. **Second, no Java source was read**: only the 703-byte README, the 3,795-byte developer guide, the 8,055-byte build file and a directory listing were read, **so nothing is claimed about the contents or strength of the test cases, which interfaces they cover, or what the support and version module groups are for; this is the item most in need of later verification**. **Third, the relationship to any regulator was not verified** — no official SUSEP or Open Insurance Brasil page was visited, whether this suite is designated as the official certification tool was not checked, and what passing it means was not established; **this entry records the repository own statements only**. **Fourth, the directory listing is a paginated enumeration capped at thirty pages**, so the figure of at least three thousand paths is a lower bound rather than a total, and the Java file count is a measured value within that range only. **Fifth, the licence was not established**: the GitLab project API reports none and no licence file was seen at the repository root, **so this entry claims no licence status, recording an absent declaration as unclear rights rather than as the absence of copyright**. **Sixth, the Terraform and httpd directories were not examined, the continuous integration file was not read, and whether the pipeline currently passes was not checked. Seventh, the maintaining organisation was not researched, and the star and fork counts on GitLab are not evidence of quality. Eighth, the creation date of 2021-12-21 is outside the thaw window while the last activity of 2026-09-08 is inside it**, and following the project convention of naming the gap, **the gap here is that a conformance test suite for a standard had no counterpart in the pool**, which covers standards, regulator data interfaces and API wrappers but not the test that decides compliance. **Ninth, this entry records what was visible on 2026-09-11. Tenth, quotation convention: ASCII apostrophes in the quoted English were rendered as curved apostrophes so that this entry contains no ASCII single quote, with the quoted text otherwise unchanged, and one misspelling in the original was preserved verbatim and noted as such.**
